fields.Name: T094 - Record Change History Timeline Filter Pills
fields.Description: Tests the history-panel type/source filter pills (ConditionalPills, TogglePill, SelectAllPill) — distinct from simply opening the history panel (T210); the pass condition is the filter behaving, not history existing.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Events' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box, click an event row, then 'Open Full Record'. In the form toolbar click the history (clock) button to open the Record Changes timeline drawer. The drawer shows a timeline of changes plus filter pills at the top (an 'All' pill and one conditional pill per change type present, e.g. 'Updates', 'Created', with counts). Click a conditional pill to filter the timeline to that change type, then click 'All' to restore. Success is the timeline RESPONDING to a pill selection (narrowing then restoring), OR — if the record has no change history — a clear empty state in the drawer. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Record Changes drawer opens showing a timeline and filter pills (All + type-specific pills with counts) OR a clear no-history empty state
Selecting a filter pill narrows the timeline to that change type and re-selecting 'All' restores the full list (when history exists)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
